item.title: Hypertrophic Cardiomyopathy (HCM) Surgery and Procedure Options: What to Know About Septal Myectomy, Septal Ablation, and Heart Transplant
item.description: Learn about surgical options for hypertrophic cardiomyopathy (HCM), including septal myectomy, septal ablation, and heart transplants.

item.title: How to Minimize Infusion Anxiety in Adults and Children With Primary Immunodeficiency
item.description: Learn to lessen the anxiety associated with SCIg for primary immunodeficiency. Get effective tips for both adults and children, including training, relaxation, and support techniques.

item.title: 5 Ways to Practice Self-Care During Ovarian Cancer Treatment
item.description: Undergoing ovarian cancer treatment presents both physical and mental challenges. Learn these self-care strategies that can help protect your well-being.

item.title: What’s Really Happening While You Wait On Ovarian Cancer Treatment Recommendations
item.description: Waiting after an ovarian cancer diagnosis and throughout the treatment process is common. Here’s why it happens and what you can do to ease your mind.

item.title: Why Am I Bleeding After Menopause?
item.description: Common causes of postmenopausal bleeding include atrophy and fibroids. Learn about risk factors, treatments, and when to consult a doctor.

item.title: Heart Disease Drug Recalled Nationwide for Leaking That Could Reduce Potency
item.description: A generic version of Vascepa, often prescribed with statins to lower heart attack risk, was recalled because oxidation is causing capsules to leak.

item.title: Is Creatine Right for Me? Uses, Benefits, and Safety Explained
item.description: Explore the benefits, uses, and side effects of creatine, a key supplement for muscle growth and athletic performance. Learn dosing tips for safety and efficacy.

item.title: Plant vs. Animal Protein: Which Is Healthier?
item.description: The new U.S. Dietary Guidelines emphasize animal-based protein over plant-based. What are the pros and cons of each? Here’s what the science says.

item.title: Sciatica During Pregnancy: Here’s What to Know
item.description: Sciatica isn’t common during pregnancy, but it can happen as a result of changing hormone levels, body shape, and more. Learn about causes and treatments.

item.title: What Are Exfoliating Gloves, and Should You Be Using Them?
item.description: You already know it’s important to exfoliate your face. Learn whether dermatologists recommend doing the same for your body, and why.
